ndps_summary.act_name: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
ndps_summary.objective: To consolidate and amend the law relating to narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and controlled substances, regulate legitimate medical and scientific use, and combat illicit trafficking and drug abuse.
key_provisions: Prohibits unauthorized production, manufacture, possession, sale, purchase, transport, warehousing, import, export and consumption of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.
Classifies offences based on small, intermediate and commercial quantities.
Provides stringent punishments for commercial quantity offences.
Regulates cultivation, manufacture and medical use through licensing.
Empowers law enforcement agencies to conduct search, seizure and arrest under prescribed procedures.
Provides for confiscation of illegally acquired property.
Prescribes procedures for sampling, storage and disposal of seized narcotic substances.

important_sections.purpose: General prohibition of unauthorized narcotic and psychotropic substance activities.
Offences relating to opium and opium poppy.
Offences relating to manufactured narcotic drugs.
Financing illicit trafficking and harbouring offenders.

references: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
